_notes: Court of Whispers: the leaning courtier. One painted still (court_of_whispers_courtier-v2.png, 1254x1254, the owner's second pass; v1 stays beside it, unused), a hooded violet figure bent from the waist toward the right with a cupped hand at the hood, on a #00FF00 green screen. Keyed on hue (keyed: "green") so the dark hood stays opaque, then cropped to its own ink. The lean is painted, so the layers only place it and slide it in: one copy as drawn, one mirrored by facing: reverse.
